title: Posts — Diskusi feed + post permalink
description: The community feed (v1.8 #29/#30) for belajar-with-rahmanef.com: members write posts in four FIXED kinds (diskusi | pengumuman | usulan | sumber — a hardcoded union, deliberately NOT a categories table), the feed itself is anonymously readable and cursor-paginated so a post permalink unfurls and indexes for a logged-out recipient. Pinned rows sort first inside one index range (by_tenant_pinned_activity). The COMPOSER, likes and the comment thread stay member-gated — that is the membership incentive. `pengumuman` additionally requires instructor+ (UX-hidden here, re-checked server-side). Likes are idempotent and score the post AUTHOR +1 point. NO FILE UPLOAD (PRD non-goal): a post carries markdown plus at most one http(s) link and one 11-char YouTube id, the embed rendering only on the permalink. Markdown is rendered through the app's single safe-subset renderer (MarkdownView from @/features/courses), never a second parser. The daily post cap WILL be hit, so RATE_LIMITED surfaces the server's Bahasa sentence, never a code. One mounted view: FeedView.

peers.reason: MarkdownView + YoutubeEmbed — the app's one safe-subset markdown/embed pair
useMyMembership drives the composer/like UX gate
